entities.summary: David "Dudi" Amsalem, is an Israeli politician. He currently serves as the Regional Cooperation Minister of Israel. He previously held the posts of Minister of Communications, the Minister for Cyber and National Digital Matters and as the Government-Knesset Liaison and was a member of the Knesset for Likud.
